//: Merge this `SessionStart` hook into your settings.json (project .claude/settings.json or global ~/.claude/settings.json). It stashes the active session UUID to `.claude/.current_session` on every session start/resume so the /branch-in-new-terminal command can fork THIS exact session. Requires `jq`. Uses $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR so it's cwd-robust.

hooks.command: mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude" && stash="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/.current_session" && rm -f "$stash" && session_id="$(jq -er '.session_id | select(type == "string" and length > 0)')" && tmp="$(mktemp "$stash.XXXXXX")" && printf '%s\n' "$session_id" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$stash"
